name: Transmogrants
description: Artificial zombie thralls created by Ashnod's process.

description_citations.text: "Ashnod". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashnod develops transmogrants and is made general of a campaign to conquer Korlis, to the dismay of Fallaji war captains.
timeline.quote: Ashnod developed a method for creating transmogrants , artificial zombies

citation.text: "Ashnod", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A Korlisian army destroys the transmogrants, Ashnod retreats to Mishra's Fortress and is sent to Sarinth.
timeline.quote: the transmogrants were all destroyed, and Ashnod had to retreat.

citation.text: "Ashnod", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Soldiers gather to watch a column of chained transmogrants being marched to the front.
timeline.quote: Hideous, piteous things that were once human, now a rotting amalgam of flesh and machine.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 4: The Ink of Empires
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 4: The Ink of Empires" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: After a bombardment, the Fallaji wave charges across no-man's-land with transmogrants and finds the Argivian trench empty.
timeline.quote: They reached the Argivian trench and found it empty.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 4: The Ink of Empires
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 4: The Ink of Empires" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

relations.quote: Her most famous creation was the process by which to create the metalloid thralls known as Transmogrants .
